purpose: Characterization only. Matching a known unsafe behavior is evidence of a limitation, not approval.

cases.name: unicode_codepoints_crlf
cases.claim: Original Python Unicode offsets survive emoji, combining marks, CRLF and trimming.

cases.name: exact_trim_contract
cases.claim: unit strips all Python isspace at both ends, including NBSP and em-space.

cases.name: invalid_unit_negative
cases.claim: Negative unit bounds are checked after trimming/indexing.

cases.name: invalid_unit_oversize
cases.claim: Oversized end can leak IndexError instead of ValueError.

cases.name: table_negative_offset
cases.claim: High-level table rejects negative offset.

cases.name: table_end_offset
cases.claim: High-level table rejects offset equal to len(text).

cases.name: paragraph_negative_offset
cases.claim: Paragraph rejects negative offset.

cases.name: list_end_offset
cases.claim: List rejects out-of-range offset.

observed.message: Offset is not inside a complete list item

cases.name: cropped_row
cases.claim: Row cropped but exact to its substring fails complete-line validation.

observed.message: Quote is not the complete original table line

cases.name: partial_header_accepted
cases.claim: A header substring with fewer source columns can pass if it matches row column count.

cases.name: unrelated_header_accepted
cases.claim: Low-level header can come from an unrelated distant table.

cases.name: same_count_wrong_header_accepted
cases.claim: Low-level validator accepts a data row as the claimed header.

cases.name: separator_as_row_accepted
cases.claim: Low-level row validator does not reject separator lines.

cases.name: header_negative_offsets_accepted
cases.claim: Header offsets may use Python negative indexing and still validate.

cases.name: high_level_column_mismatch
cases.claim: High-level rejects row/header/separator column mismatch.

cases.name: high_level_malformed_intervening_row
cases.claim: High-level ignores malformed intervening pipe-start rows.

cases.name: high_level_separator_as_header
cases.claim: Consecutive separators cause nearest separator's preceding separator to be labeled header.

cases.name: high_level_missing_outer_pipes
cases.claim: Optional-outer-pipe Markdown tables are outside supported format.

observed.message: A complete table row needs both outer pipes

cases.name: escaped_pipe_odd
cases.claim: Odd backslash run escapes a pipe without changing the original text.

cases.name: escaped_pipe_even
cases.claim: Even backslash run leaves the pipe a delimiter.

cases.name: escaped_final_outer_pipe
cases.claim: An escaped final pipe is still treated as a complete outer boundary.

cases.name: table_in_fence
cases.claim: Table-like lines inside fenced code are accepted as a table.

cases.name: paragraph_heading_swallowed
cases.claim: Paragraph helper groups ATX heading and following text without blank line.

cases.name: paragraph_cr_only
cases.claim: CR-only paragraphs are not blank-line delimited by the LF regex.

cases.name: paragraph_blank_offset
cases.claim: Offset in LF blank separation rejects.

observed.message: Offset selects blank separation rather than content

cases.name: paragraph_crlf
cases.claim: CRLF blank separation works and trims line endings.

cases.name: list_child_omits_parent
cases.claim: Nested child selection contains no governing parent text.

cases.name: list_indented_heading_swallowed
cases.claim: Indented ATX heading without blank line does not terminate list selection.

cases.name: list_setext_swallowed
cases.claim: Setext heading without blank line does not terminate list selection.

cases.name: list_tab_nested_unsupported
cases.claim: Tab-indented nested item is not recognized as a child item.

cases.name: list_fenced_bullet_selected_as_child
cases.claim: A bullet-like line inside an indented fenced block is selected as a nested child.

cases.name: list_blank_then_outside
cases.claim: Blank line followed by unindented prose terminates item.

cases.name: text_validator_mirrors_extractor
cases.claim: Text validator accepts the same heading-containing paragraph as its extractor.

cases.name: unicode_line_separators
cases.claim: splitlines recognizes Unicode line separators although paragraph regex recognizes LF only.

cases.name: unit_negative_bounds_can_be_normalized
cases.claim: Invalid negative start can be silently normalized when final character is whitespace.

cases.name: wrong_header_count_rejected
cases.claim: Low-level count check catches a header with a different number of cells.

cases.name: mutated_quote_rejected
cases.claim: Exact span matching rejects changed row text.

observed.message: Quote differs from original Unicode span

cases.name: table_gap_blocks_unrelated_header
cases.claim: Blank separation prevents high-level reuse of an earlier table header.

cases.name: table_newline_offset_returns_row
cases.claim: A source offset on a row's newline selects the row even though trimmed span excludes offset.

cases.name: paragraph_absorbs_adjacent_list
cases.claim: Blank-line paragraph selection absorbs an adjacent list without blank separation.

cases.name: nested_parent_continuation_excluded_from_child
cases.claim: A blank line and dedented parent continuation ends a child item, while parent retains it.

cases.name: ordered_item_continuation
cases.claim: Ordered items with parenthesized markers retain indented continuation and stop at sibling.

cases.name: no_separator_rejected
cases.claim: High-level extractor rejects pipe rows without a preceding separator.

cases.name: high_level_separator_target_rejected
cases.claim: High-level extractor rejects a separator as selected row.

observed.message: Separator is not a data row
